
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/halfcode/p/22291850" title="发布于 2026-08-06 23:05">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">5. PyCharm×鸿蒙Hypium：从0到跑通，少踩90%坑</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>配套的动画视频在：<a href="https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1tDgS6mEWF/" rel="noopener nofollow">《5. PyCharm×鸿蒙Hypium：从0到跑通，少踩90%坑》</a>。</p>
<p>打开鸿蒙官方(https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/download/)，下载命令行工具和自动化测试开发库。开发工具用PyCharm社区2025.1版的，下载command-line-tools6.1和DevEco Testing Hypium 6.1。</p>
<p><img alt="[图片]" class="eva3-bili-image lazyload" data-eva3-scoped="" data-size="695.56" data-width="2560" data-height="1440" data-url="http://i0.hdslb.com/bfs/new_dyn/351873ce6d5f44b6e51d6ae24741447c3546912993053582.png" data-ai-gen-pic="0" data-eva-image="enhanced" data-pm-slice="0 0 []" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202608/1919157-20260806225905053-1419032232.png"></p>
<p>PyCharm 2026版本的，则下载command-line-tools 26.0版和DevEco Testing Hypium 26.0。</p>
<p><img alt="[图片]" class="eva3-bili-image lazyload" data-eva3-scoped="" data-size="665.91" data-width="2560" data-height="1440" data-url="http://i0.hdslb.com/bfs/new_dyn/336b0b81f320168ea9111aaeb78717663546912993053582.png" data-ai-gen-pic="0" data-eva-image="enhanced" data-pm-slice="0 0 []" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202608/1919157-20260806225905068-202779235.png"></p>
<p>建议将解压后的工具直接放在项目里，方便后期迁移。项目在E:\AutoTest下，解压缩之后，在项目中存放的形式如下：</p>
<p>E:\AutoTest\command-line-tools</p>
<p>E:\AutoTest\hypium-6.1.0.210 文件夹下存放如下：</p>
<p>hypium-6.1.0.210-py3-none-any.whl</p>
<p>hypium-pycharm-plugin-6.1.0.210.zip</p>
<p>xdevice-6.1.0.210-py3-none-any.whl</p>
<p>xdevice_devicetest-6.1.0.210-py3-none-any.whl xdevice_ohos-6.1.0.210-py3-none-any.whl</p>
<p><img alt="[图片]" class="eva3-bili-image lazyload" data-eva3-scoped="" data-size="1263.41" data-width="2560" data-height="1440" data-url="http://i0.hdslb.com/bfs/new_dyn/1361f88df59b7579bc55fe85ab3d65a93546912993053582.png" data-ai-gen-pic="0" data-eva-image="enhanced" data-pm-slice="0 0 []" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202608/1919157-20260806225905268-805716977.png"></p>
<p>接下来，先来配置命令行运行环境，打开菜单【File】，选择【Settings】，找到Tools下面的【Terminal】。</p>
<p><img alt="[图片]" class="eva3-bili-image lazyload" data-eva3-scoped="" data-size="1000.07" data-width="2560" data-height="1440" data-url="http://i0.hdslb.com/bfs/new_dyn/80db05baf26d8b3e71a073589ed26b723546912993053582.png" data-ai-gen-pic="0" data-eva-image="enhanced" data-pm-slice="0 0 []" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202608/1919157-20260806225905189-1381317918.png"></p>
<p>在右边找到 【Environment variables】并点击最右边的图标，打开配置窗口。</p>
<p><img alt="[图片]" class="eva3-bili-image lazyload" data-eva3-scoped="" data-size="1001.95" data-width="2560" data-height="1440" data-url="http://i0.hdslb.com/bfs/new_dyn/bed4ce2e0553dac628123a79a447d3ab3546912993053582.png" data-ai-gen-pic="0" data-eva-image="enhanced" data-pm-slice="0 0 []" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202608/1919157-20260806225905203-1651430523.png"></p>
<p>&nbsp;打开的窗口中，name填写：PATH；value：填写命令工具所在的目录，末尾用;分隔之后并且添加%PATH%，完整值如下：</p>
<p>E:\\hypium_test\\command-line-tools\\sdk\\default\\openharmony\\toolchains;%PATH%</p>
<p>按下【OK】按钮，进行保存。</p>
<p><img alt="[图片]" class="eva3-bili-image lazyload" data-eva3-scoped="" data-size="1123.46" data-width="2560" data-height="1440" data-url="http://i0.hdslb.com/bfs/new_dyn/0d3e4a9eef841eac240b20c4fb2561593546912993053582.png" data-ai-gen-pic="0" data-eva-image="enhanced" data-pm-slice="0 0 []" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202608/1919157-20260806230018538-1249694079.png"></p>
<p>在返回的窗口中，按下【Apply】按钮，进行确定保存。</p>
<p><img alt="[图片]" class="eva3-bili-image lazyload" data-eva3-scoped="" data-size="1145.96" data-width="2560" data-height="1440" data-url="http://i0.hdslb.com/bfs/new_dyn/7525fae4cdc6662d04072389f319998b3546912993053582.png" data-ai-gen-pic="0" data-eva-image="enhanced" data-pm-slice="0 0 []" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202608/1919157-20260806230018516-222064324.png"></p>
<p>找到左侧的【Plugins】选项并进行点击。</p>
<p><img alt="[图片]" class="eva3-bili-image lazyload" data-eva3-scoped="" data-size="1162.16" data-width="2560" data-height="1440" data-url="http://i0.hdslb.com/bfs/new_dyn/3063b97b5d6490775955852b0bbab7b83546912993053582.png" data-ai-gen-pic="0" data-eva-image="enhanced" data-pm-slice="0 0 []" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202608/1919157-20260806230018566-1820062773.png"></p>
<p>在右边窗口，有个配置按钮，选择【Install Plugin from Disk…】</p>
<p><img alt="[图片]" class="eva3-bili-image lazyload" data-eva3-scoped="" data-size="1232.35" data-width="2560" data-height="1440" data-url="http://i0.hdslb.com/bfs/new_dyn/fd40faf97d0d0d6d3d95588e1a7672be3546912993053582.png" data-ai-gen-pic="0" data-eva-image="enhanced" data-pm-slice="0 0 []" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202608/1919157-20260806230018573-2050162303.png"></p>
<p>&nbsp;选择hypium-pycharm-plugin-6.1.0.210.zip，PyCharm会自动进行安装。</p>
<p>&nbsp;<img alt="[图片]" class="eva3-bili-image lazyload" data-eva3-scoped="" data-size="1067.35" data-width="2560" data-height="1440" data-url="http://i0.hdslb.com/bfs/new_dyn/6e6038c536a19d4784d41cb00bfc7d093546912993053582.png" data-ai-gen-pic="0" data-eva-image="enhanced" data-pm-slice="0 0 []" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202608/1919157-20260806230117191-769435724.png"></p>
<p>安装完之后，要按下【Restart IDE】按钮，重启PyCharm之后，插件才能生效。</p>
<p><img alt="[图片]" class="eva3-bili-image lazyload" data-eva3-scoped="" data-size="1130.73" data-width="2560" data-height="1440" data-url="http://i0.hdslb.com/bfs/new_dyn/6b4c8b2b6bd15af137a6ad48f174496b3546912993053582.png" data-ai-gen-pic="0" data-eva-image="enhanced" data-pm-slice="0 0 []" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202608/1919157-20260806230117223-1545253598.png"></p>
<p>接下来还需要配置hdc.exe命令，好同步手机镜像。打开菜单【File】，选择【Settings】，在左侧菜单栏的最下面，就可以看到刚刚安装的插件【DevEco Testing Hypium】，点击之后，眼光移到右边窗口。</p>
<p><img alt="[图片]" class="eva3-bili-image lazyload" data-eva3-scoped="" data-size="1075.53" data-width="2560" data-height="1440" data-url="http://i0.hdslb.com/bfs/new_dyn/a02326426fcf5bda1f63b82d1ad6d0823546912993053582.png" data-ai-gen-pic="0" data-eva-image="enhanced" data-pm-slice="0 0 []" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202608/1919157-20260806230117147-585588720.png"></p>
<p>找到Hdc路径，找到command-line-tools下面，找到hdc.exe，下面是完整目录：</p>
<p>E:/hypium_test/command-line-tools/sdk/default/openharmony/toolchains/hdc.exe</p>
<p>按下【Apply】按钮之后，配置就全部完成了。</p>
<p><img alt="[图片]" class="eva3-bili-image lazyload" data-eva3-scoped="" data-size="961.67" data-width="2560" data-height="1440" data-url="http://i0.hdslb.com/bfs/new_dyn/4eff05be5b1e374e008597c3fa7a5e573546912993053582.png" data-ai-gen-pic="0" data-eva-image="enhanced" data-pm-slice="0 0 []" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202608/1919157-20260806230117111-2116220863.png"></p>
<p>&nbsp;要用 hypium进行开发的话，还需要安装开发包。打开命令行窗口，输入如下命令，进入到开发包目录下。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>cd hypium-6.1.0.210</pre>
</div>
<p><img alt="[图片]" class="eva3-bili-image lazyload" data-eva3-scoped="" data-size="652.27" data-width="2560" data-height="1440" data-url="http://i0.hdslb.com/bfs/new_dyn/c27cef94e4175a590e0353ffb61a14753546912993053582.png" data-ai-gen-pic="0" data-eva-image="enhanced" data-pm-slice="0 0 []" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202608/1919157-20260806230306792-1721876031.png"></p>
<p>&nbsp;后面的开发包需要用到前面的，要按照顺序进行安装才行。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>pip install xdevice-6.1.0.210-py3-none-any.whl xdevice_devicetest-6.1.0.210-py3-none-any.whl xdevice_ohos-6.1.0.210-py3-none-any.whl hypium-6.1.0.210-py3-none-any.whl</pre>
</div>
<p><img alt="[图片]" class="eva3-bili-image lazyload" data-eva3-scoped="" data-size="1646.42" data-width="2560" data-height="1440" data-url="http://i0.hdslb.com/bfs/new_dyn/3e7d1063f4c1ce5b77bc67f4aec77d693546912993053582.png" data-ai-gen-pic="0" data-eva-image="enhanced" data-pm-slice="0 0 []" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202608/1919157-20260806230307200-1217321910.png"></p>
<p>&nbsp;重新打开一个命令行窗口，输入如下命令，如果能看到手机的序列号，说明hdc通信可以了。当前，前提是你先将手机，通过USB数据线接到电脑上才能看到。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>hdc list targets</pre>
</div>
<p><img alt="[图片]" class="eva3-bili-image lazyload" data-eva3-scoped="" data-size="696.53" data-width="2560" data-height="1440" data-url="http://i0.hdslb.com/bfs/new_dyn/8b231a3f872c24beaba10c43b60ee5a83546912993053582.png" data-ai-gen-pic="0" data-eva-image="enhanced" data-pm-slice="0 0 []" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202608/1919157-20260806230306838-1230401852.png"></p>
<p>打开右边UIView面板，如果可以看到手机镜像，说明插件安装和配置没问题。</p>
<p><img alt="[图片]" class="eva3-bili-image lazyload" data-eva3-scoped="" data-size="1988.61" data-width="2560" data-height="1440" data-url="http://i0.hdslb.com/bfs/new_dyn/61506d6ceb86b4c9c99ff6faa8fa0e953546912993053582.png" data-ai-gen-pic="0" data-eva-image="enhanced" data-pm-slice="0 0 []" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202608/1919157-20260806230307271-1947130453.png"></p>
<p>打开命令行窗口，如下如下命令，安装我们将要测试的app。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>hdc install myapp.hap</pre>
</div>
<p><img alt="[图片]" class="eva3-bili-image lazyload" data-eva3-scoped="" data-size="897.63" data-width="2560" data-height="1440" data-url="http://i0.hdslb.com/bfs/new_dyn/c73d25f659e5b5fdad2f8c5e606fa39b3546912993053582.png" data-ai-gen-pic="0" data-eva-image="enhanced" data-pm-slice="0 0 []" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202608/1919157-20260806230538678-236676625.png"></p>
<p>再次打开镜像窗口，如果可以看到myapp的logo，那配置就大功告成了，可以放心，大胆的进行下一节，开发截图功能。</p>
<p><img alt="[图片]" class="eva3-bili-image lazyload" data-eva3-scoped="" data-size="2024.54" data-width="2560" data-height="1440" data-url="http://i0.hdslb.com/bfs/new_dyn/d50bd9c552b8e383f5955123aa7a1d6a3546912993053582.png" data-ai-gen-pic="0" data-eva-image="enhanced" data-pm-slice="0 0 []" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202608/1919157-20260806230539081-341332026.png"></p>
<p>配套的动画视频在：<a href="https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1tDgS6mEWF/" rel="noopener nofollow">《5. PyCharm×鸿蒙Hypium：从0到跑通，少踩90%坑》</a>。</p>
